Identical agent behavior, different scores => borderline sem-judge non-determinism, not a deterministic agent bug. This is flaky per eval_pass_rates routing (2/3, N=3). The older run 075cbfd9 (17:20, pre-round-1 baseline) shows the original turn-3 failure mode for contrast, confirming round-1 fixed it.
